title: Composition of the five closed-Hom bijections
statement: Let A,B,C have specified closed tensor-Hom structures [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], with adjunctions F⊣U and G⊣W and natural strong tensor comparisons mu and nu. Suppose the tensor comparison mu0 for GF is G(mu) followed by nu at each pair. Then the five-bijection comparison [lem-sfb-closed-scalar-hom-comparison] for the composite adjunction equals U of the comparison for G followed by the comparison for F. This is an equality of actual component maps, not an existence statement.

proof.text: Use the representing identity for the first comparison and expand the five equivalences for the composite adjunction. Its hom equivalence is the composite of the two scalar hom equivalences. Cancel the final closed transpose and first scalar transpose by injectivity.

proof.text: Move the first scalar counit through the second closed transpose by precomposition naturality. Write the second comparison as its value at the identity in the five-bijection formula, then cancel the intermediate closed equivalence with its inverse. Naturality of the second scalar transpose and nu leaves precisely G(mu) followed by nu. The stated tensor-composition equation identifies this with mu0.
